title: Construction Industry Scheme: CIS 340
text: This guidance explains the roles of both contractors and subcontractors within the Construction Industry Scheme.
changeNote: Section 4.12 has been updated to explain that you need to provide your 13-character reference number when making payments to HMRC. A link to paying employers' PAYE has also been added.
